title: Count Magical Substring Pairs I
statement: The task is to count triplets i <= j < k that split s[i..k] into adjacent substrings s[i..j] and s[j+1..k] with the same number of distinct characters, for a lowercase string of length up to 2000. Fixing the split point j, one counts left substrings ending at j and right substrings starting at j+1 by distinct count 1..26 and sums the products; n <= 2000 admits an O(n^2) scan.
